title: Metrovpn v2.7.4 Critical TLS & TUN Fix
message: Fixes critical Xray-core v26.11.9 TLS crashes (migrates allowInsecure=1 and IP/self-signed TLS nodes to automatic pinnedPeerCertSha256 leaf-cert pinning, expands VCN/host verification, forces WS/HTTPUpgrade ALPN to http/1.1, migrates legacy H2 to XHTTP stream-one), eliminates Windows TUN DNS routing deadlocks (direct IPv4 TUN dial + AsIs routing + Win32 GetBestRoute gateway pinning + TUN metric=1), fixes standalone .exe core upgrades, and adds post-connect live TLS tunnel verification.
